title: [recoverability] a notes file moved or copied since the bundle is not a mismatch of the sync drill (its bytes are in the backup); only bytes the backup does not hold stay one
prompt:
Spawn, objective 224 [recoverability] (the lead's YES of 2026-11-18 21:4x, after the first supervised run of the sync drill failed; author rev-i; readers rev-k first, rev-j second): a notes file moved or copied since the bundle is not a mismatch of `spawn backup restore-drill --only sync` (objective 217).

Base: live main b701a85f (217 landed: owner c4fbfabd, fleet 299249af).

The problem: the lead's first supervised run of spawn-backup-restore-drill-sync.service (2026-11-18 20:37-21:29) exited 1 with 41 mismatches against bundle incr spawn-bundle-20261118-014245 (event 175185). All 41 are under sync/obj-212/r2-b2cdde0a/. That directory was born at 11:26:19, after the bundle began at 09:42:45: 212's R2 package was moved aside with mkdir + mv when R3 was made, and a rename keeps the files' mtimes (09:03). So each moved file reads as "a live file the manifest lacks, last written before the bundle began: the backup lacks it", though its bytes are in the backup under the old path. Moving a round aside (r1/, r2-<seal>/) is how every author keeps packages, so the drill would fail again.

Read first: crates/spawn-cli/src/backup/restore_drill/sync.rs (compare, read_live, Compared, the module doc).

What changes:
(1) In compare, a live file the newest manifest lacks under its path, not said apart and last written before the bundle's start, is read once (read_live: O_NOFOLLOW, no wait). When its size and sha256 are a file of the newest manifest (any path), it is "moved or copied since" (expected). When it cannot be read, a mismatch "sync/<path>: live cannot be read: ...". When it is gone by then, nothing. Otherwise a mismatch, said "sync/<path>: live, last written <t>, before the bundle began (<t>), is not in the backup, under this path or any other".
(2) Compared gains `moved`; its line says "<n> moved or copied since" right after "<n> made since". A manifest file whose path is gone live stays "removed since"; its copy elsewhere counts as moved or copied (so cp -a, both paths live, reads right).
(3) read_live also gives the file's size.
(4) The module doc says the rule and why.

What stays as it is: every other rule of the comparison (the same, changed since, removed since, made since, said apart, the mismatches of a manifest file), the restore, the record and its shape, the unit, the timer (still disabled), every other drill. Only the live files that the manifest lacks and that predate the bundle are read: no other read is added.

Files: crates/spawn-cli/src/backup/restore_drill/sync.rs (with its unit tests); owner: rsi/scenarios/224.sh, rsi/backlog/224.json.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/224.sh, black box in 217.sh's world (its own database, scratch HOME and GNUPGHOME, 104's R2 stand-in, a real full and increment over a made-up notes folder), the drill given --into a scratch parent:
- (2) the drill passes, every file the same, "0 moved or copied since";
- (3) after the bundle, mkdir r1 and mv obj-7 r1/obj-7 (a bundled subfolder moved aside, its files older than the bundle): exit 0, "N removed since", "N moved or copied since", 0 mismatch(es), the record ok true;
- (4) a bundled file copied with cp -p beside itself: exit 0, "1 moved or copied since";
- (5) an old file of bytes the backup does not hold, and one of a bundled file's size with other bytes: exit 1, 2 mismatches, each "is not in the backup, under this path or any other", the record ok false with 2;
- (5b) a cp -p copy of a bundled file made unreadable (mode 000): exit 1, one mismatch "live cannot be read", never moved (a harness failure under root);
- (6) every drill leaves the folder as it was; no secret or file content in any output or record.
On live main b701a85f, 224.sh exits 1. 217.sh still passes.

Tests (unit, sync.rs): a subfolder moved aside and a file copied beside itself count as moved or copied, their old paths removed since; old bytes not held stay mismatches, a file of a held size with other bytes included; an old file the manifest lacks that cannot be read is a mismatch, never moved. The existing comparison test's expected line gains "0 moved or copied since". No test is renamed or dropped.

Verified by: after landing, the lead's next supervised run of spawn-backup-restore-drill-sync.service on live exits 0 (obj-212/r2-b2cdde0a's 41 files moved or copied since), and records backup.drilled.sync ok true.
